verdict.rationale: Users can choose between keeping data entirely on-device and sending it to RunAnywhere's hosted cloud. On-device processing keeps prompts, audio and images on the phone, and the developer confirms local use collects no data. Hosted versus local execution is an explicit choice, and requests leave the machine only when the user says so. That gives real control over where data lives, but the evidence never mentions choosing a geographic region or data residency for the hosted Wally Cloud. Missing for 10: cloud region selection, documented data-residency or storage-location guarantees for hosted requests, independent corroboration.
